name: Protocol Reconstruction & Analysis
description: Ability to reconstruct and analyse network protocols from captured traffic. Covers TCP stream reassembly, HTTP/HTTPS session reconstruction, DNS analysis, email protocol reconstruction (SMTP/IMAP), file carving from network streams, and analysis of encrypted protocol metadata.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to forensic protocol reconstruction

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands common network protocols and the concept of session reconstruction from packet data
evidence: Can describe TCP/IP fundamentals and common application protocols
Understands the concept of stream reassembly and session reconstruction
Can explain why protocol analysis is important for forensic investigations

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reconstructs common protocol sessions from PCAP files using forensic tools under supervision
evidence: Reassembled TCP streams and followed HTTP sessions in Wireshark under guidance
Extracted files transferred via HTTP and FTP from PCAP files
Reconstructed DNS query/response sequences to map domain resolution activity
Documented protocol analysis findings with supervisor review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently reconstructs multi-protocol sessions and extracts forensic evidence from network traffic
evidence: Independently reconstructed application sessions in 5+ network forensics investigations
Carved files and extracted credentials from captured network traffic
Correlated DNS, HTTP, and TLS metadata to establish communication patterns
Produced protocol analysis reports accepted in case findings

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex protocol analysis including custom protocols, tunnelling, and encrypted traffic metadata analysis
evidence: Analysed custom or proprietary protocols by reverse-engineering wire formats
Identified tunnelled traffic (DNS tunnelling, HTTP tunnelling, ICMP covert channels)
Extracted meaningful intelligence from TLS metadata without decryption (JA3/JA4, certificate analysis)
Developed Wireshark dissectors or Zeek scripts for novel protocol analysis

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines protocol analysis methodology; researches new protocol forensic artifacts; recognised as authority in network evidence interpretation
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's protocol reconstruction and analysis methodology
Published research on protocol forensic artifacts or reconstruction techniques
Provides expert testimony on network evidence derived from protocol reconstruction
Trains teams on advanced protocol analysis and network evidence interpretation

assessment_methods.description: Given a PCAP file from a simulated incident, reconstruct all application sessions, extract transferred files, and identify malicious communication patterns
Analyse PCAP containing encrypted and tunnelled traffic to identify covert communication channels and extract available metadata
